CustomMetadata.label: External users see only their own data

values.value: External users, such as volunteers or partners on an Experience Cloud site, should only see their own records. Set the external sharing default for Account and Contact to Private and grant access with sharing sets.
There are no active external users, or the external sharing default for Account and Contact is Private.
Checks whether you have active external (community, portal or partner) users, and if so whether the external sharing default for Account and Contact is Private.
